description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pohoddaramulla, Kalutara D/S Division, Kalutara District  - Cad. Map No. 530014
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, owners, extent, and other land-related details) in various locations. The content focuses on land ownership, title registration, and property determinations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
